one_liner: Graph database and managed cloud (Aura) with management, query, and GraphQL APIs.
access_notes: Aura accounts (including Free) can self-create API client credentials; DB/query access uses per-instance username/password or SSO without any partner review.
mcp_notes: Official Neo4j MCP server maintained by Neo4j; see docs at https://neo4j.com/docs/mcp/current/ (authentication: https://neo4j.com/docs/mcp/current/authentication/).
blocker_notes: Buildable now, but Aura Free imposes low rate limits (about 25 requests/min; ~125 rpm on Pro) that can constrain management/API usage; no review or partnership required.
